ns2:course.label: Cities in a Global Perspective
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the process of urbanization from a global perspective by exploring the social, political, cultural and economic forces that shape urban life. Students will learn to analyze urban development in a range of cities including those in the Middle East and South Asia, Latin America and Africa.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Cultural Studies - Non-West, and Social & Beh Sci - Soc Sci course.
